name: PvPToggle
author: Sleelin
description: Allows players to decide whether or not they want PvP enabled

commands.name: pvp
commands.description: main command used by the plugin

commands.name: pvpt
commands.description: alternate command used by the plugin

commands.name: tpvp
commands.description: alternate command used by the plugin

permissions.name: pvptoggle
permissions.description: Gives someone full use of the PvPToggle plugin

permissions.name: pvptoggle.use
permissions.description: Allows players to be affected by PvPToggle

permissions.name: pvptoggle.self
permissions.description: Allows players to use /pvp command on themselves

permissions.name: pvptoggle.self.toggle
permissions.description: Whether or not a player is allowed to toggle their own PvP

permissions.name: pvptoggle.self.status
permissions.description: Whether a player can check their own PvP status in a world

permissions.name: pvptoggle.other
permissions.description: Allows players to use /pvp command on others

permissions.name: pvptoggle.other.toggle
permissions.description: Whether or not a player is allowed to toggle someone else's PvP

permissions.name: pvptoggle.other.status
permissions.description: Whether a player can check someone else's PvP status

permissions.name: pvptoggle.other.reset
permissions.description: Whether a player can reset someone else's PvP status to default

permissions.name: pvptoggle.world
permissions.description: Allows players to modify world-specific PvP

permissions.name: pvptoggle.world.toggle
permissions.description: Whether or not a player is allowed to toggle world-wide PvP

permissions.name: pvptoggle.world.status
permissions.description: Whether a player can check a world's PvP status

permissions.name: pvptoggle.world.reset
permissions.description: Whether a player can reset PvP for all players in a world

permissions.name: pvptoggle.global
permissions.description: Allows players to modify server-wide global PvP

permissions.name: pvptoggle.global.toggle
permissions.description: Whether or not a player is allowed to toggle server-wide PvP

permissions.name: pvptoggle.global.status
permissions.description: Whether a player can check server-wide PvP status

permissions.name: pvptoggle.global.reset
permissions.description: Whether a player can reset server-wide PvP status to default in all worlds

permissions.name: pvptoggle.pvp
permissions.description: SuperPerms is fucking retarded

permissions.name: pvptoggle.pvp.force
permissions.description: Force player PvP enabled

permissions.name: pvptoggle.pvp.deny
permissions.description: Force player PvP disabled

permissions.name: pvptoggle.pvp.autoenable
permissions.description: Automatically enable PvP on combat

permissions.name: pvptoggle.pvp.bypass
permissions.description: Bypass the cooldown period of player PvPing

permissions.name: pvptoggle.pvp.bypass.warmup
permissions.description: Bypass the warmup period of player PvPing

permissions.name: pvptoggle.pvp.bypass.cooldown
permissions.description: Bypass the cooldown period of player PvPing

permissions.name: pvptoggle.admin
permissions.description: Allows a player to toggle the PvP status of any other player or world

permissions.name: pvptoggle.regions
permissions.description: Whether or not a player is allowed to add or remove regions

permissions.name: pvptoggle.regions.add
permissions.description: Whether or not a player is allowed to add a region

permissions.name: pvptoggle.regions.remove
permissions.description: Whether or not a player is allowed to remove a region
